page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the top of a psalm (verses 2 to 9) above a new heading, "PSALMVS CL. VI. VERS.", a subtitle line, and verses 1 and 2 below. A printer's mark sits at the lower right. No notes in the margins. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.l: Idem tuus Rex, læta Sion tum[?]æ.
4. Rex plebe gaudet, ceu tua Rege plebs
9. Iusti è quadrigis in titulo gerent,

page.notes: Verse 2 "tuæ" is printed with an unclear letter, read as "tum[?]æ". Verse 3 "iuncta" is hard to read. Verse 5 "inhebunt" may be a printing error for a different verb. The printer's mark at the lower right is copied as a foot line. The psalm heading CL is the psalm number 150, given as caput.
